question: Vedic religion was also known as ________.
solution:
__
 
• Vedic religion was also known as **Brahmanism**__.
 
• It is a form of Hinduism which revolves around ritual ideologies and mythic vision presented by the Vedas.
 
• Buddhism was founded by Siddhartha Gautama.
 
• Jainism was founded by Mahavira.
 
• __**Hedonism was founded by Aristippus**__. It is a philosophy which believes that pleasure and pain are the only things that matter to the physical wellbeing of a human being.
